user.title: FLARE
user.description:
Installs both halves. Schedules provides the day-phase and colour curve sensors; Tracking registers the apply_lighting, compute_lighting_groups, compute_curve, compute_scene_coverage and ownership services and keeps track of which lights are currently being driven.

Pick the rooms to track - each becomes a tracking scope with its own controlled/overridden counts and a Clear button. Lights in an area you don't pick simply aren't tracked, which means they're never left alone when something else takes them. You can add, retarget or remove these at any time, and add schedule sensors from the Schedules entry once it exists.

user.title: Add a FLARE schedule sensor
user.description: Adds a day-phase/curve sensor and phase-override select, grouped under a device with this name. Entities are prefixed with it too (e.g. "Living Room" -> sensor.living_room_flare). The schedule times and brightness/colour curve aren't set here - they're separate entities on the device once it's created, each starting at a sensible default and adjustable any time.

user.title: Add tracking scope
user.description: A tracking scope is a named record of which lights FLARE is currently driving, usually one per room. Which lights it tracks is decided by whichever automation or service call passes its ID as tracking_device_id — not by anything set here. Optionally point it at an area, device, or lights just to place it under that area in Settings → Devices for tidiness.

confirm.title: Update the FLARE blueprint
confirm.description:
FLARE's integration and blueprint are installed separately, and the blueprint you have is older than the one this release ships with ({current}).

{blueprints}

Submitting downloads version {current} and replaces the copies above, then reloads the automations using them. Your automations keep their settings.

If you've edited the blueprint yourself, don't submit this - ignore the repair instead, since updating would overwrite your changes.

init.title: FLARE options
init.description:
Bulb models that need two-step transitions, one pattern per line. Any light whose device matches one of these patterns is routed into two-step transitions automatically, with no label needed — the box starts pre-filled with the models shipped with the integration, and you can add to it or remove from it freely.

Patterns are matched case-insensitively against “manufacturer model”, and * is a wildcard, e.g. *TRADFRI bulb* or IKEA*. Clearing the box entirely falls back to the shipped defaults, so it can't quietly switch off detection.

Once you save your own list it stays as you left it — a later release adding a newly discovered bulb won't change it.
